newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen remaining weak on campaign.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen remaining weak on campaign.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen remaining weak on Friday on worries about rising political tensions and soft regional markets, brokers said.
"I don't see any news that could boost sentiment at this time. Players are cautious about what would happen next during the election campaign," one broker said.
Campaign violence continued across Java on Thursday with sporadic clashes between supporters of the ruling party Golkar and the minority United Development Party (PPP).

Brokers, however, said local speculative buying was likely to continue in small stocks, particularly in tyre cord manufacturer Branta Mulia following a proposed purchase of a stake in the firm by Du Pont.
Chemical firm Eterindo Wahanatama was scheduled to be listed on Friday, with an initial offer price of 1,300 rupiah per share.
Brokers said they felt the listing would get a lukewarm response due to overall weak market sentiment.
On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index closed 13.30 points down at 656.99 points. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
Debut-making chemical firm Eterindo Wahanatama, was the most active stock and traded at 1,425 rupiah against an initial offer price of 1,300 rupiah.
Brokers said Eterindo managed to make the modest gains despite the overall weak sentiment due partly to support from the issuer and underwriters.
